name: html-resolved-split-grid-stays-group
description: A two-child split container resolved as CSS grid stays a core/group so source grid tracks and alignment are not replaced by Gutenberg Columns flex geometry.

source_reference.notes: Uses a generic split-layout class that the columns recognizer accepts without resolved-style awareness. The resolved CSS grid must take precedence over the class-name heuristic.

legacy_comparison.reason: Covers current PHP transformer resolved-layout behavior; no downstream legacy comparison.
